## Checklist

<!-- Check all that apply. -->

- [ ] I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md) guide
- [ ] Tests are written and passing (`make test`)
- [ ] All Lua versions pass (5.2, 5.3, 5.4)
- [ ] Linting passes (`make lint`)
- [ ] Code follows the project conventions (naming, style, etc.)
- [ ] Documentation is updated (README, inline docs, templates if applicable)
- [ ] Commit message follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) format
- [ ] The related issue is linked (`Closes #N` in commit footer)
- [ ] No new dependencies were added (or approval was obtained)
- [ ] This PR targets the `dev` branch
